purpose: One fresh maximum-source engineering control of a measurable repository-owned authenticated local publisher

accounting.domain: Exact HTTP application request and response body bytes for every attempted publisher operation
excluded: post-control evidence preservation and independent public audit
accounting.authentication: Automatic repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN stays within the owned Actions job; no credential value is written or returned
accounting.responses: Bounded admission before dispatch; every response body is retained with exact SHA256 and byte count
accounting.storage: Actual source and body receipts are charged together by logical and allocated bytes; no named-pipe or trace omission
accounting.processes: Publisher is one Python process with zero subprocess children; supervisor measures complete direct-child wait4 lifetime plus procfs and its own peak
accounting.runtime: Record the actual hosted Python and standard-library/runtime identities before launch; this engineering inventory grants no future native execution authority

publication.first_stage: Publish code, workflow and this protocol without an activation marker; independently verify every immutable byte
publication.second_stage: Marker-only direct-child commit binds the preparation commit and complete readback; one public push attempt only
publication.workflow: Standard ubuntu-24.04 public runner; no artifacts, cache, larger runner or paid service
publication.branch_guard: Exact fixed repository and science branch; late head check; GraphQL updateRefs requires beforeOid=the exact parent, afterOid=the exact verified candidate and force=false; exact final head readback
publication.cas_mechanism: One GraphQL updateRefs mutation for one fixed ref; no REST update-ref fallback, retry or second publication attempt
publication.one_shot: Require one workflow run for the activation SHA, attempt1, and an absent owned namespace; no retries, reruns, resume or scope reuse
publication.trust_boundary: Standing repository publication uses non-force updates; adversarial administrator branch rollback or workflow-run deletion is outside this component proof
